instruction.text: Find the lighthouse to learn more about storms.

text: When there is a storm in the UK, we normally get lots of rain, wind and big waves.
In this photo, a storm has blown over a tree and damaged a building.

instruction.text: Find the water to learn more about floods.

feedback.end: Floods normally happen when there is a lot of rain. The worst floods happen when rivers burst their banks and buildings fill with water.

instruction.text: Select the image of a thunderstorm to learn more.

feedback.end: Thunderstorms are electrical storms and can be very dangerous. We should avoid being in the open during thunderstorms because of the lightning.

instruction.text: Drag the pictures of extreme weather to the correct label.
Does this image show a storm or a flood? Decide quickly.

feedback.finish: Great work! Floods and storms are the most common types of extreme weather in the UK, but they also happen in other parts of the world.
